    19  We define `finiteInterClosure` which, given a set `S` of subsets of `α`, is the smallest

    30  variable {α : Type*} (S : Set (Set α))
    31  
    32  /-- A structure encapsulating the fact that a set of sets is closed under finite intersection. -/
    33  structure FiniteInter : Prop where
    34    /-- `univ_mem` states that `Set.univ` is in `S`. -/
    35    univ_mem : Set.univ ∈ S
    36    /-- `inter_mem` states that any two intersections of sets in `S` is also in `S`. -/
    37    inter_mem : ∀ ⦃s⦄, s ∈ S → ∀ ⦃t⦄, t ∈ S → s ∩ t ∈ S
    38  
    39  namespace FiniteInter

    41  /-- The smallest set of sets containing `S` which is closed under finite intersections. -/
    42  inductive finiteInterClosure : Set (Set α)

    44    | univ : finiteInterClosure Set.univ
